blocks.text: Autoimmune bimariyan tab hoti hain jab immune system jism ke apne cells aur bairooni cheezon mein farq nahin kar pata. Is soorat mein immune system jism ke apne cells aur tissues par hamla kar ke unhein tabah karta hai. Kuch autoimmune bimariyan yeh hain:

items: Myasthenia gravis (MG) muscles ki kamzori ki bimari hai jis mein mareez apne hi skeletal muscle cells par lage acetylcholine receptors ke khilaf antibodies banate hain. Antibodies muscle ke receptors se jur jati hain, is liye muscles acetylcholine ka jawab nahin dete aur nerve impulse (asab ka paigham) muscle tak nahin pohanch pata.
Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) aisi autoimmune bimari hai jis mein mareez apne hi connective tissues aur bare aaza (organs) ke khilaf antibodies banata hai.
Rheumatoid arthritis: arthritis (jorron ki bimari) ki is qism mein mareez jorron ke cartilage wale tissue ke khilaf antibodies banata hai jo unhein nuqsan pohanchati hain.

Type I diabetes (Juvenile diabetes, kam umri ki diabetes) aisi autoimmune bimari hai jis mein antibodies pancreas ke insulin banane wale cells ko tabah kar deti hain. Autoimmune bimariyon ke ilaaj ki zyada tar dawaen poori immunity ko hi daba (suppress kar) deti hain.
